kitEvidence.formula: Xerath calls down a blast of arcane energy, dealing [50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + (0.65) × AP] magic damage and Slowing them by [25]% for [2.5] seconds. Enemies in the center take [(50 / 85 / 120 / 155 / 190 + (0.65) × AP) × (1.667)] magic damage instead and are Slowed by [(0.6 / 0.65 / 0.7 / 0.75 / 0.8) × 100]%, decaying over [2.5] seconds.

builds.name: Rite of the Arcane: six-shot ramp test
builds.summary: Investigate high one six-shot Rite of the Arcane sequence output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one six-shot Rite of the Arcane sequence output with a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-3 R permits six shots in ten seconds. Each base helper is 270 + 0.45 AP magic, and the ramp helper is 30 + 0.05 AP per champion hit. Verify whether ramp is applied before or after each hit and what persists across shots; the full ramp must not be granted to every shot from the start.

ceiling.targetName: one six-shot Rite of the Arcane sequence
ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 20000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 10s. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers; Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. No free permanent stacks. Stop damage at death, cap healing at recipient missing HP, and report raw output separately. Seraph transformed and Riftmaker legally pre-ramped. One surviving 20000-max-HP champion, no other champions hit, all six shots legally fired and connected within one ten-second ultimate. Record actual ramp before every impact and item-ramp retention across delays. No extra recasts or Q/W/E damage.
